node.label: adrenomyeloneuropathy
node.definition: An adult form of the peroxisomal disease X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy (X-ALD), characterized by spastic paraparesia and often associated with peripheral adrenal insufficiency in males. Both males and females can be affected with AMN.

evidence.snippet: Computed phenotype similarity. simGIC = IC-weighted Jaccard over ancestor-closed HPO term sets (Pesquita 2008); Resnik-BMA = best-match average of the IC of the most informative common ancestor (Resnik 1995); IC = -ln(share of 12865 HPO-annotated diseases with the term or a descendant); 82 of 223 ancestor-closed terms shared; rank = position in the source's / target's similarity list. simGIC 0.252 · Resnik-BMA 2.56 over 7 shared terms · top: HP:0007199 Progressive spastic paraparesis (IC 7.16) · rank 1/6 Counterexample candidate: different curated mechanism class, no shared causal gene.

edge.formula: simGIC 0.252 · Resnik-BMA 2.56 over 7 shared terms · top: HP:0007199 Progressive spastic paraparesis (IC 7.16) · rank 1/6

neighbours.mechanism_note: Similar symptoms, different cause. adrenomyeloneuropathy: peroxisomal biogenesis / peroxisomal enzyme or transporter defect (via MONDO:0019053 peroxisomal disease). adult Krabbe disease: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails) (via MONDO:0002561 lysosomal storage disease). No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.25. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review. Reactome: no shared specific pathway between the causal genes.
